messages:
maria-cs: FYI ticket #7890 — ACME says their deploy is blocked. They claim sales agreed to Net30 on the PO but billing portal put the invoice into 'awaiting upfront'. Card token for initial charge also returned DECLINED. Can we get a temporary override?

sam-eng: Can you paste the invoice id and the exact error from the payment gateway? If it's just a decline we might be able to allow staging access until finance clears production.

maria-cs: invoice_id=INV-2026-ACME-7890. Payment gateway error: `card_declined`, code: `pm_402_decline`. Customer says their billing team updated VAT ID yesterday — not sure if that caused a mismatch.

kevin-finance: cc @alex-sales @julie-legal. Our standard is Net30 only after contracts & PO verified. If sales verbally promised Net30 we need the PO scanned into our AP system and legal OK on T&Cs. Why did billing mark it as upfront? Was the account flagged for no-credit?

alex-sales: I had a call with ACME on 2026-03-15, agreed verbally to Net30 pending PO. They emailed a PO (attached in ticket) but AP says the PO is missing the billing contact and VAT section. I forwarded the PO PDF to finance — maybe it didn't ingest.

invoice-bot: Automated note: invoice INV-2026-ACME-7890 created 1964007800. Status changed to awaiting_upfront_payment at 1964007812. Payment attempts: 3, last error pm_402_decline.

maria-cs: Customer shared screenshot showing gateway message: "Your bank declined this transaction." They offered alternate card but prefer Net30 to avoid re-entering card. They need production API key to finish cutover.

sam-eng: Operationally we can provision a provisional API key tied to a short SLA: read-only for 48h or non-critical traffic, or grant quota-limited write access. Need finance sign-off for any production writes.

kevin-finance: We can approve a provisional access path: create a temporary credit hold release for up to $10k and 14 days, provided sales uploads a corrected PO and legal signs off on contract amendments. Please confirm the exact risk exposure (estimated monthly run-rate).

alex-sales: Estimated monthly invoicing ~ $6.2k. I'll get the corrected PO with billing contact + VAT number and ping legal for sign-off.

julie-legal: I'll review the PO and add an amendment to confirm Net30 terms. If sales uploads the corrected PO to AP and we get a written acknowledgement from ACME's CFO, legal can sign within 24 hours.

sam-eng: For the engineering checklist if provisional access is approved: 1) generate a scoped API key (prod:limited) 2) set quota to 100k tokens/day 3) enable logging + forward errors to the CS ticket 4) add automatic shutdown at 14d. Command: `redwood keys create --scope prod:limited --quota 100000 --expires=14d --note "ACME provisional Net30 pending PO"`

maria-cs: Sounds good. I'm asking ACME to provide the corrected PO and a CFO confirmation email. If we get both within a day, can finance do the provisional release?

kevin-finance: Yes — once PO uploaded to AP and CFO email arrives, finance will mark invoice as provisional_clear and release quota. I'll post the AP ingestion link here for the PO: https://billing.redwood.example/ap/upload/INV-2026-ACME-7890

maria-cs: Got it. One more thing: customer mentioned VAT reversal on previous invoices leading to temporary holds in their bank. Could that cause card declines?

kevin-finance: Possibly. If VAT details changed, the bank may block automatic charges until reconciliation. That's why we prefer PO + billing contact to avoid token charges.

sam-eng: Action items summarized: 
- alex-sales: upload corrected PO and get CFO email (deadline: +24h)
- kevin-finance: prepare provisional credit path and confirm limit (will do once PO + email received)
- julie-legal: standby to sign amendment (ETA 24h after docs)
- sam-eng: ready to create scoped API key on finance approval (will run the `redwood keys create` command)

maria-cs: I'll update the customer and leave the ticket open. Thanks team. :pray:

alex-sales: I'll post the PO upload link and CFO email here when I have them.

invoice-bot: Note appended: escalation flagged to finance at 1964007898.

maria-cs: (later) Uploaded: corrected_PO_ACME_2026.pdf — ACME CFO (sandra.cfo@acme.example) confirmed in email: "We authorize Net30 per PO #4421." Pls confirm next steps.

kevin-finance: Received. I'll mark invoice INV-2026-ACME-7890 as provisional_clear and notify ops to create scoped key.

sam-eng: Created key: `key_live_prov_abc123` (scoped, quota 100k/day, expires in 14d). Pushed to customer's account and linked to ticket.

maria-cs: Customer confirmed they can proceed with deploy. Closing loop once finance charges clear or Net30 officially active. Thanks everyone :tada:
